title: Raise default_statistics_target 100->300 for skewed GetUserTweets selectivity
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=100 leaves coarse MCV/histogram resolution for the heavily skewed user_id predicate driving GetUserTweets (88% of terminal capacity); planner estimates stay coarse and per-call page work is not minimized.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.88) with p50 171us and p99 1092us. Its predicate on user_id is highly skewed; at statistics target 100 the MCV list and histogram under-resolve the hot user_id values, so the planner's row estimate for the dominant template is coarse and it may pick a plan that touches more heap pages per call than necessary. Raising default_statistics_target to 300 triples histogram/MCV resolution for skewed columns, sharpening selectivity estimates and letting the planner choose the tighter index path. This is a planner/statistics knob, orthogonal to the WAL and predicate-lock bundles already tested; it targets the dominant transaction's per-call page work rather than commit-path queueing.
query_effect: Finer user_id selectivity estimates should let the planner pick a tighter index path for the dominant GetUserTweets template, reducing pages touched per call and lowering its p50/p95 latency.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful transaction TPS as GetUserTweets terminal occupancy falls; effect bounded because the dominant cost is per-call index work, not commit path.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p50 and p95 decrease; other transaction classes roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Finer MCV/histogram resolution for skewed user_id yields tighter index path and fewer pages per call.
Sharper selectivity estimates reduce worst-case page work for the dominant template.
Lower GetUserTweets terminal occupancy frees finite client terminal capacity for more completed transactions.

alternatives.statement: If the dominant GetUserTweets plan is already index-only and insensitive to selectivity resolution, statistics target has no measurable effect and p50 stays flat.
If commit-path WAL sync (sync_average_ms ~0.13ms, wal_waiting_backends max 1) is the true limiter, GetUserTweets latency is unchanged and only WAL bundle knobs move TPS.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves default_statistics_target at 100; the dominant transaction is a skewed-predicate lookup whose plan quality depends on statistics resolution. Raising to 300 is a low-risk, orthogonal planner lever not yet tested, with a distinct measurable prediction on GetUserTweets p50/p95.

nodes.label: Finer user_id selectivity estimates tighten GetUserTweets index path

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Triple from 100 to 300 within safe [50,500]; 3x histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id while keeping ANALYZE cost bounded.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed predicate selectivity

cross_domain_requirements: ANALYZE must run after the change so new statistics are visible to the planner before measurement.
